claims.text: The network uses mean square error as the loss function for final classification, which outperformed binary cross entropy in this context.
RMSprop is employed for parameter optimization during training of the network.
GloVe vectors are used as pre-trained word embeddings to initialize the word embeddings lookup table.
The output of the network is processed using softmax to interpret classification results as probabilities.
Word dropout is mentioned as a technique that improves generalization in the network.
